title: ATG - All the Gear
description: Ever saw the ATO mod and wondered were all the gear is at? This mod fixes that.
body:
This mod adds the gear for the ATO - All the Ores mod, which was missing armor, tools and weapons.

Curseforge version will come soon. The ATO mod is not on Modrinth, so I can not make a depencency without it being here. I will link the mod here: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ato

Mod can technically be used without ATO, there will be no crashes but the recipes will not work.

Currently adds:

- Copper Gear
- Aluminum Gear

The rest of the tool and armor sets will be created over time, I just wanted to put this mod out there first.

Also this is **NOT** an offical ATMTeam mod, I created this in my own vision.
